name: Haunting Imitation
oracle_text: Each player reveals the top card of their library. For each creature card revealed this way, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's 1/1, it's a Spirit in addition to its other types, and it has flying. If no creature cards were revealed this way, return Haunting Imitation to its owner's hand.
blocked_sentences: If no creature cards were revealed this way, return Haunting Imitation to its owner's hand.

needs.what: an op an instant or sorcery runs during its own resolution that puts the resolving spell card into its owner's hand instead of the graveyard, usable conditionally inside an `if` (here: no creature card was among the cards bound by the per-player reveals)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `_place_after_resolution` sends the spell to its graveyard unconditionally after `spell_effects` run, with no check of the object's zone, so a `return_to_hand` of the spell mid-resolution would be undone; `return_spell_to_hand` reads a spell target, not the resolving spell; the self-redirect riders (`buyback`, `exiles_itself`, `tucks_itself`, `suspends_itself`, `exile_spell_on_resolution`) are either card-level and unconditional, gated on a paid cost, or send the card to exile rather than to hand. The rest of the card (for_each_player snapshot+reveal of the top card, copy_permanent of the bound card with except_ power/toughness 1, add_subtypes Spirit, add_keywords flying) is expressible
